note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the arguments, exhibits and the links between them are as supplied: a link means only that the party invokes that exhibit (as supplied) and carries no legal assessment (nothing is proved or weighed, no side is preferred, no outcome; jurisdiction unspecified).
